_doc: F3 ablation anchor — SSRC on top of the 'NPU+PIM only' axis (no AAU / EDC / TVC). Shares DRAM/NPU base with ahasd_none, adds ssrc_enable=true. Combined with ahasd_ssrc_aau / ahasd_ssrc_edc / ahasd_ssrc_full it forms a 4-step progressive ablation identical to D1 but with SSRC stacked on every cell.
